rich_narrative.summary: The Islamic Society of Greater Houston provides local religious and social services to community members. Founded in 1969, the charity maintains <cite id="4">an program expense data unavailable</cite> to support regional initiatives [4]. Program activities include <cite id="1">weekend Islamic schools, funeral care, job networking, and food distribution</cite> [1]. According to its annual tracking, the organization distributed <cite id="4">11 million meals to families in need</cite> [4]. It also delivered healthcare assistance to <cite id="4">118,908 beneficiaries</cite> [4]. Educational programs reached <cite id="4">34,835 students through local schools</cite> [4]. The organization accepts zakat to support eligible local categories like the poor and needy [11].
